Reflex test that was attached was configured with CBC in the analyzer master setup.

helpdesk-note.body: Setup change and details has been email to the site person. After further discussion with you, I have remain the same setup as before. HBANF4 (Hb Ana F4 (Rpt)) as reflect test for HBANAF4. Hb Analysis (HBANLYS) - LIS need to send FBC + Slide Hb Analysis Form 4 (HBANF4) - LIS need to send Slide ONLY For your information, LIS can send order using the single test only not group test. To send the FBC order for Hb Analysis, I have create 1 new single test CBCREMI as dummy. This is to void duplicate FBC sent to the analyzer. Below is the order details send to analyzer : 6/2/2026 12:37:19 S:1H|\^&|||WST|||||REMISOL||P|1|202602061202<CR>A6<CR><LF> 6/2/2026 12:37:19 R:<ACK> 6/2/2026 12:37:19 S:2P|1||EX00451746||DUMMY 12x TESTING ANALYZER^ ||19850325|F|||||DD||||||||||||BDUT|||||||||<CR>DA<CR><LF> 6/2/2026 12:37:19 R:<ACK> 6/2/2026 12:37:19 S:3O|1|2026028324||^^^CBC\^^^SLIDE_SS|R||20260206122620|||||||||||||||||||||||<CR>27<CR><LF>
helpdesk-note.body-html:
Setup change and details has been email to the site person.
After further discussion with you, I have remain the same setup as before. HBANF4 (Hb Ana F4 (Rpt)) as reflect test for HBANAF4.

  1. Hb Analysis (HBANLYS) -  LIS need to send FBC + Slide
  2. Hb Analysis Form 4 (HBANF4) - LIS need to send Slide ONLY

For your information, LIS can send order using the single test only not group test.

helpdesk-note.body: Hi Muhammad Hafiz Bin Mat Zuber, As per checking, TROPI1 have auto release setting in Master - Analyzer. HIL alos have auto release setting in Master - Analyzer. However, analyzer (REMISOL) didnt send result for HIL. When the result for TROPI1 was send by analyzer, this result automatically complete (when in auto release range). The HIL remain pending as no result receive from the analyzer. Then user enter result entry and release the specimen then ALL test was complete. User need to release the HIL to clear the pending specimen as HIL are still pending. But we cant see it in WHODUNIT, because there is no result was enter for HIL it was release because of the test was not essential. System will take the last date release and show it at footer of specimen result report. That why the person who release the HIL their name appeared as authorized user. ​Below is the simulation done in TESTING (1026000047) 1. Order new specimen (GLU) 2. Run the script to execute auto release 3. Add in H 4. Then click Release When you view specimen result report, my name appeared at the footer. If you have queries. please contact us. Regards, AdeaHub
helpdesk-note.body-html:
Hi Muhammad Hafiz Bin Mat Zuber,

As per checking, TROPI1 have auto release setting in Master - Analyzer.
HIL alos have auto release setting in Master - Analyzer.

However, analyzer (REMISOL) didnt send result for HIL. 
When the result for TROPI1 was send by analyzer, this result automatically complete (when in auto release range).

The HIL remain pending as no result receive from the analyzer.
 
Then user enter result entry and release the specimen then ALL test was complete.
User need to release the HIL to clear the pending specimen as HIL are still pending.
But we cant see it in WHODUNIT, because there is no result was enter for HIL it was release because of the test was not essential.

System will take the last date release and show it at footer of specimen result report. That why the person who release the HIL their name appeared as authorized user.

​Below is the simulation done in TESTING (1026000047)
1. Order new specimen (GLU)
2. Run the script to execute auto release 


3. Add in H
4. Then click Release

When you view specimen result report, my name appeared at the footer.

If you have queries. please contact us.

Regards,
AdeaHub

helpdesk-ticket.description: Request for setup a new Meal Type - Sahur, for Doctor On-Call on Meal Order for Staff. And enable Therapeutic Diet on Diet Type; Diabetic Diet (DD), Diabetic Low Salt Diet (DDLS), and Low Salt Diet (LSD). (Attached is a Word document of what I have testing setup on Training EM HIS for DIET - Meal Order for Staff) This request was submitted by user [CRF #11707] at ticket [ServiceDesk #11194] (Attached below as PDF file is the CRF) Below is the requirements confirmed by user; 1. The user have agreed that Sahur will be configured as a Meal Type rather than a Diet Type, as this better aligns with their workflow. Consequently, I will remove it from the Diet Type configuration and the Order Catalog on the Testing. 2. Regarding the meal period, the user has accepted the previously configured serving time starting at 20:00 (8:00 PM). 3. Additionally, the user inquired about cut-off times for Meal Types. For example, if the cut-off time for staff to order lunch is 09:00 AM, is there a specific configuration required to automatically remove 'Lunch' from the Meal Type drop-down once that time has passed? 4. helpdesk-ticket.description:
We had upgraded Oracle client to 19C in DR server(SHSMIEVRINT03) and Installed Delphi 6 complied NCC OAS INQ services and .Dlls. On 19 dec, we switched the OAS INQ , OAS INQ1 and BAR_INQ services from MIE server(SHSMIEVPINT01AC) to DR server(SHSMIEVRINT03). We have attached the OAS INQ1 stats during the peak hour 09:00-11:00 on 19 dec (dedicated DR server) compared with 16 dec (MIE server). The average time taken to process an OAS INQ message is ~2.3 seconds in Dedicated DR server, same as MIE server. During peak time each OAS INQ thread can receive upto 25-30 messages per minute, gradually increasing the queuing time. In comparison with SGH production, OAS INQ messages take on average 0.9 second to process. SGH and NCCS has the same InQ processor and dll version. INQProcessorService.exe - v320 SHSADTDLL.dll - v362
Kindly help to check why NCCS OAS INQ is 2.5x slow to process a message, when compared to SGH OAS INQ
Additional, (Dhana )SYNAPXE team have raised a concern that the same OAS slowness issue have been seen in SKH production as well, And both SKH and NCCS have same OPAS (RXPRESS). He wanted to check SHSRxPOPASRDSDLL.dll(v320) logic of updating INKW_MSG_STATUS =U , Since for such messages the INKW_PROCESSED_AT is not updated (NULL). He needs to know if any records are inserted or updated in maxcare tables apart from inqueue table. i.e double confirm that OPAS RDSO01 messages are not causing any deadlock that is causing this OAS slowness.
helpdesk-ticket.subject: NCCS OAS ADTA08 messages causing slowness in INQueue processing during peak hours SR3447000
helpdesk-ticket.description-html:
We had upgraded Oracle client to 19C in DR server(SHSMIEVRINT03) and Installed Delphi 6 complied NCC OAS INQ services and .Dlls.  On 19 dec, we switched the OAS INQ , OAS INQ1 and BAR_INQ services from MIE server(SHSMIEVPINT01AC) to DR server(SHSMIEVRINT03). We have attached the OAS INQ1 stats during the peak hour 09:00-11:00 on 19 dec  (dedicated DR server) compared with 16 dec (MIE server). The average time taken to process an OAS INQ message is ~2.3 seconds in Dedicated DR server, same as MIE server.  During peak time each OAS INQ thread can receive upto 25-30 messages per minute, gradually increasing the queuing time.  In comparison with SGH production, OAS INQ messages take on average 0.9 second to process. 
SGH and NCCS has the same InQ processor  and dll version.
INQProcessorService.exe  - v320
SHSADTDLL.dll - v362
 
Kindly help to check why NCCS OAS INQ  is 2.5x slow to process a message,  when compared to SGH OAS INQ
 
Additional, (Dhana )SYNAPXE  team have raised a concern that the same OAS slowness issue have been seen in SKH production as well, And both SKH and NCCS have same OPAS (RXPRESS).   He wanted to check SHSRxPOPASRDSDLL.dll(v320) logic of updating INKW_MSG_STATUS =U , Since for such messages the INKW_PROCESSED_AT is not updated (NULL). He needs to know if any records are inserted or updated in maxcare tables apart from inqueue table. i.e  double confirm that OPAS RDSO01 messages are not causing any deadlock that is causing this OAS slowness.

helpdesk-note.body: Hi Dhana and Wei May, The following changes have been made in the trigger by our developer. Removed the INKW_CENTRE condition from all WHERE clauses. Reordered the WHERE clause to place indexed columns (INKW_MSG_STATUS, INKW_SCHEDULED_AT) at the beginning. Retained the Oracle index hint /*+ INDEX(INQUEUE INKW_SCHEDULE_N) */ in the SELECT statement. Applied the TRUNC(SYSDATE) condition in the WHERE clause Kindly help to review the trigger and let us know if we can proceed to implement in UAT server
helpdesk-note.body-html:
Hi Dhana and Wei May,


The following changes have been made in the trigger by our developer.
  • Removed the INKW_CENTRE condition from all WHERE clauses.
  • Reordered the WHERE clause to place indexed columns (INKW_MSG_STATUS, INKW_SCHEDULED_AT) at the beginning.
  • Retained the Oracle index hint /*+ INDEX(INQUEUE INKW_SCHEDULE_N) */ in the SELECT statement.
  • Applied the TRUNC(SYSDATE) condition in the WHERE clause
Kindly help to review the trigger and let us know if we can proceed  to implement in UAT server

helpdesk-ticket.description-html: Please kindly help to check on this. The quantity computed by Maxcare for 520mg is 10 X100mg even though we have set it in UOM mapping as 1 AMPVIA is 5 x 100mg in item master.

helpdesk-note.body: Hi Wei May, The Primary UOM for 0022-19-67X-8 - ISATUXIMAB 500 MG/ 25 ML INJ (SARCLISA) (100MG) is EA UOM conversion is 1 EA= 5 X100MG Order Qty in SCM message 520 mg 520 mg > 500mg(1 EA) , therefore calculated qty = 2 EA (sales multiple is 1) For this order the qty calculated by SCM dll is 2 EA = 10x100 MG. Item table Item_uom table Item_Store Sales multiple
helpdesk-note.body-html:
Hi Wei May, 

The Primary UOM  for 0022-19-67X-8 -  ISATUXIMAB 500 MG/ 25 ML INJ (SARCLISA) (100MG) is EA 
UOM conversion is 1 EA= 5 X100MG
Order Qty in SCM message 520 mg  
520 mg > 500mg(1 EA) , therefore calculated qty = 2 EA (sales multiple is 1)

For this order the qty calculated by SCM dll  is 2 EA = 10x100 MG. 

Item table
Item_uom table
Item_Store Sales multiple

helpdesk-note.body: NCCS user wants SCM dll calculated qty for this item to be 6x100MG for SCM order 520 mg ONCE. We had done some testing in UAT for similar item, after setting Decimal to 2 from 0 and unit Dose multiple to 0.01 from 1 Primary UOM =EA , sales UOM =x1000MG , UOM conversion 1EA=5x1000MG SCM order qty is 8016 MG , calculated by SCM .dll is 1.7 EA = 1.7x5 x1000MG = 8.5x1000MG (sales multiple is 1)-> rounded to 9x1000MG Waiting for feedback from Developer safter SCM .dll code analysis. "We would like to know the logic behind how SCM .dll calculates order qty and which UOM and multiple is being used for calculation and also if we are to set ITST_MULTIPLE_UNIT_DOSE to 0.01 from 1 , are there any implications/impact on other calculations or functions in Maxcare"
helpdesk-note.body-html:
NCCS user wants SCM dll calculated qty for this item to be 6x100MG for SCM order 520 mg ONCE.
We had done some testing in UAT for similar item, after setting Decimal to 2 from 0 and unit Dose multiple to 0.01 from 1
Primary UOM =EA , sales UOM =x1000MG , UOM conversion 1EA=5x1000MG
SCM order qty is 8016 MG , 
calculated by SCM .dll  is 1.7 EA = 1.7x5 x1000MG = 8.5x1000MG (sales multiple is 1)-> rounded to 9x1000MG

Waiting for feedback from Developer safter SCM .dll code analysis.
"We would like to know the logic behind how SCM .dll calculates order qty and which UOM and multiple is being used for calculation and also if we are to set ITST_MULTIPLE_UNIT_DOSE to 0.01 from 1 , are there any implications/impact on other calculations or functions in Maxcare"

helpdesk-ticket.description: We would like to know the last login date/time of EM HIS application user and is there any way to collect the logfile for the user activity log in the EM. We are using below query to find the user last login in EM application, In that we could see some users last login shows as NULL. Example, Sahar ID the last login is getting updated but for my account shows NULL since I tried to logged in HIS today. select A.APPL_USER_ID USERID,A.APPL_USER_NAME USERNAME,A.ADDED_DATE CREATIONDATE,B.RESP_ID,C.RESP_NAME,A.EFF_STATUS STATUS,A.MODIFIED_DATE, (SELECT MAX(Login_date) FROM SM_APPL_USER_AUDIT WHERE APPL_USER_ID = A.APPL_USER_ID )LAST_LOGIN_DATE from SM_APPL_USER A, SM_RESP_FOR_USER B, SM_RESP C where A.APPL_USER_ID=B.APPL_USER_ID and B.RESP_ID=C.RESP_ID and A.APPL_USER_ID='AMBI' Kindly let us know to get the correct report with last login or if any configuration is missing let us know to enable, which is required for External Audit. If above query logic is wrong let us know In which EM application report we can get it this details.
helpdesk-ticket.subject: MMS-DM-SCF-1097 : We are using below query to find the user last login in EM application, In that we could see some users last login shows as NULL.
helpdesk-ticket.description-html:
We would like to know the last login date/time of EM HIS application user and is there any way to collect the logfile for the user activity log in the EM.
 
We are using below query to find the user last login in EM application, In that we could see some users last login shows as NULL. 
 
Example, Sahar ID the last login is getting updated but for my account shows NULL since I tried to logged in HIS today.
 
select A.APPL_USER_ID USERID,A.APPL_USER_NAME USERNAME,A.ADDED_DATE CREATIONDATE,B.RESP_ID,C.RESP_NAME,A.EFF_STATUS STATUS,A.MODIFIED_DATE,
(SELECT MAX(Login_date) FROM  SM_APPL_USER_AUDIT WHERE APPL_USER_ID = A.APPL_USER_ID )LAST_LOGIN_DATE
from SM_APPL_USER A, SM_RESP_FOR_USER B,
SM_RESP C
where A.APPL_USER_ID=B.APPL_USER_ID
and B.RESP_ID=C.RESP_ID
and A.APPL_USER_ID='AMBI'
 
Kindly let us know to get the correct report with last login or if any configuration is missing let us know to enable, which is required for External Audit.
 
If above query logic is wrong let us know In which EM application report we can get it this details.

helpdesk-ticket.subject: Missing Supporting Diagnosis Codes in HIS (ICD-10 2010)
helpdesk-ticket.description-html:
We have identified that the following “Supporting Diagnosis” codes are not available in the HIS:
  1. Y70–Y82 – Medical devices associated with adverse incidents in diagnostic and therapeutic use
  2. Y60–Y65 – Misadventures to patients during surgical and medical care

helpdesk-ticket.description: LAB Order status - Option to reject the specimen for taking a second sample without impacting the order and bill Current Workflow Order lab services> Specimen Collection> Manage Specimen > If the lab wants to reject the specimen, and to take another sample order will also be cancelled Needed Workflow Order lab services> Specimen Collection> Manage Specimen > If lab wants to reject the specimen, they can reject the specimen only and can take another sample as the order will still be active.
helpdesk-ticket.subject: MMS-DM-CRF-0299 : LAB Order status - Option to reject the specimen for taking a second sample without impacting the order and bill
helpdesk-ticket.description-html:
LAB Order status - Option to reject the specimen for taking a second sample without impacting the order and bill
 
Current Workflow
 
Order lab services> Specimen Collection> Manage Specimen > If the lab wants to reject the specimen, and to take another sample order will also be cancelled
 
Needed Workflow
 
Order lab services> Specimen Collection> Manage Specimen > If lab wants to reject the specimen, they can reject the specimen only and can take another sample as the order will still be active.

helpdesk-note.body: อัพเดทข้อมูลเพิ่มเติมค่ะ ทาง User เเจ้งว่าสาเหตุน่าจะเกิดจากการสั่งยาผูกน้ำเกลือ เหมือนน้ำเกลือกับยาอยู่เเยกกันไม่มาด้วยกัน ซึ่งลองทำการ Deliver ยาที่ละตัวเเล้วไม่ได้ ยกเลิกการจองสต๊อกเเล้วไม่ได้ค่ะ เเต่ user เเก้ไขหน้างานไปก่อนโดย คีย์ขายใหม่เพื่อให้คนไข้ D/S ได้ก่อน
helpdesk-note.body-html:

helpdesk-ticket.description: The GRN price is different from the Average Unit Cost because the HIS system includes opening stock and all GRNs in its calculations. This makes the average cost different from the actual spending. Ideally, issuing should follow the GRN price by batch, but the current HIS 12.x system uses the Average Unit Cost instead.

helpdesk-note.body:
Hi Shyam,
With all due respect, we understand that the customer is well aware of all the functional flows. However, I would like to bring to your attention that in the MMS-DM-SCF-1088 document, the behaviour of the orders in Existing Order at Line Level was not mentioned. The document only states that the customer is attempting to cancel the order at the Header level. There is no information provided regarding the missing order both at the Header & Line level in the MMS-DM-SCF-1088 document. Due to the absence of this clarification, we have concluded that customer was trying cancel at the header level.
Regards,
Devayani Functional Testing

helpdesk-note.body:
Hi Idrus,
A merge was performed from PRN X---386G to PRN Sxxxx335A on 16 Feb 2026. [cid:image004.png@01DCA4E9.07153D80] On 09 Feb, Maxcare received a CMIS message from OAS using PRN Sxxxx335A. However, Maxcare did not receive any merge message from either OAS or ISH on 09 Feb 2026. Subsequently, in the Inqueue, Maxcare received SCM and SMM messages using PRN X---386G up until 10 Feb 2026. On 16 Feb 2026, Maxcare received a merged message from OAS to merge X ---386G and Sxxxx335A on 16 Feb 2026. The merge message A34 was processed successfully. [cid:image001.png@01DCA4ED.2258C680]

helpdesk-note.body-html:
Hi Idrus,
 
A merge was performed from PRN X---386G to PRN Sxxxx335A on 16 Feb 2026.
On 09 Feb, Maxcare received a CMIS message from OAS using PRN Sxxxx335A.  However, Maxcare did not receive any merge message from either OAS or ISH on 09 Feb 2026.
Subsequently, in the Inqueue, Maxcare received SCM and SMM messages using PRN X---386G up until 10 Feb 2026.
 
On 16 Feb 2026, Maxcare received a merged message from OAS to merge X ---386G and Sxxxx335A on 16 Feb 2026.  The merge message A34 was processed successfully.
 
Please advise if any further investigation is required for this case, or if we may proceed to close this issue.
 
Regards,
Jade

helpdesk-note.body: Hi Kingkanda Sodchuan, เมื่อ Interface ครั้งแรกสำเร็จแล้ว และมีการ Interface ด้วยรายการซ้ำของผู้ป่วยรายเดียวกันอีกครั้ง ระบบจะตรวจสอบพบว่าเป็นรายการที่มีอยู่ในระบบ EM (eHIS) แล้วจึงเกิด Error ตามที่แจ้งมา โดยโปรแกรม Interface จะล้างรายการในระบบ EM เมื่อ Interface อีกครั้งจึงไม่เกิด Error เป็นเช่นนี้สลับกันไป ดังนี้เพื่อไม่ให้เกิดปัญหานี้ จะต้องส่งคำสั่ง CLEAR_EHIS_DATA ก่อนคำสั่ง EXECUTE_INTF_DATA ทุกครั้ง Regards, AdeaHub
helpdesk-note.body-html:
Hi Kingkanda Sodchuan,

เมื่อ Interface ครั้งแรกสำเร็จแล้ว และมีการ Interface ด้วยรายการซ้ำของผู้ป่วยรายเดียวกันอีกครั้ง ระบบจะตรวจสอบพบว่าเป็นรายการที่มีอยู่ในระบบ EM (eHIS) แล้วจึงเกิด Error ตามที่แจ้งมา โดยโปรแกรม Interface จะล้างรายการในระบบ EM เมื่อ Interface อีกครั้งจึงไม่เกิด Error เป็นเช่นนี้สลับกันไป
ดังนี้เพื่อไม่ให้เกิดปัญหานี้ จะต้องส่งคำสั่ง CLEAR_EHIS_DATA ก่อนคำสั่ง EXECUTE_INTF_DATA ทุกครั้ง

Regards,
AdeaHub

helpdesk-ticket.description: During the past month, BUPA had implemented a change to restrict accepting the claim which same bill date/same visit (with Multiple Pre-auth numbers), however those sent for claims separately, this is no acceptable any more by BUPA. BUPA are enforcing to group all encounter invoices/all pre-auth to be sent in ONE claim only. this change apply for all OP poly-clinics, So beside the CRF-259, to group all invoices per one encounter together, (but split by pre-auth). What is requested now is to group everything in 1 claims. (for each encounter irrespective of Preuath, count of invoices, 1 claim only should be submitted) This change will apply for all payer groups , Except Tawuniya, they need to group all pre-auth/invoices (similar like BUPA) but need to split per claim type , Professional/Pharmacy or Oral/Pharmacy . Please consider this change as critical. as it's hitting claims process directly. As shown below, BUPA they are rejecting the 2nd invoice, of the encounter, as it has same bill date/same encounter ID but sent in separate claim. (due to different pre-auth)
helpdesk-ticket.subject: NMC-JD-CRF-0262 | BUPA Insurance Claims should be grouped per encounter Level,
helpdesk-ticket.description-html:
During the past month,

BUPA had implemented a change to restrict accepting the claim which same bill date/same visit (with Multiple Pre-auth numbers), however those sent for claims separately, this is no acceptable any more by BUPA. 

BUPA are enforcing to group all encounter invoices/all pre-auth to be sent in ONE claim only. this change apply for all OP poly-clinics,

So beside the CRF-259, to group all invoices per one encounter together, (but split by pre-auth).
What is requested now is to group everything in 1 claims. (for each encounter irrespective of Preuath, count of invoices, 1 claim only should be submitted)

This change will apply for all payer groups , Except Tawuniya, they need to group all pre-auth/invoices (similar like BUPA)  but need to split per claim type , Professional/Pharmacy   or Oral/Pharmacy .

Please consider this change as critical. as it's hitting claims process directly.

As shown below, BUPA they are rejecting the 2nd invoice, of the encounter, as it has same bill date/same encounter ID but sent in separate claim. (due to different pre-auth)

For example If the user entered the search criteria of the date range in RCM transaction screen, From Bill date as 1st Jan 2026 and To Bill Date as 31st Jan 2026 and Press the Search button, then system fetching the 1st Feb 2026 Bills as well to the front end screen which is wrong.

helpdesk-ticket.description: NMC-JD-SCF-0434: Generate Documents/In Error screen throwing Java error if the number of records fetched are more than 50 in the front end. For example If the user entered the search criteria of the date range in Generate Documents/In Error screen, From Bill date as 1st Jan 2026 and To Bill Date as 31st Jan 2026 and Press the Search button, then system fetching the encounters to the front end screen, after fetching around 50 records system throwing Java code break error. Most of the times error was like ‘Cursor exceeded parse error’. In the Database, DBA increased the number of open cursors to maximum 3000 but still the same issue. Proposed solution is to introduce the pagination and fetch the records per page or introduce the Tile like Dashboard function and do not fetch the individual encounters.
helpdesk-ticket.subject: NMC-JD-SCF-0434: Generate Documents/In Error screen throwing Java error if the number of records fetched are more than 50 in the front end.

Most of the times error was like ‘Cursor exceeded parse error’. 
In the Database, DBA increased the number of open cursors to maximum 3000 but still the same issue.
Proposed solution is to introduce the pagination and fetch the records per page or introduce the Tile like Dashboard function and do not fetch the individual encounters.

helpdesk-ticket.description: NMC-JD-SCF-0436: Claims follow-up functionality not working as expected. If we send the follow-up claim to the claim which is in approved status then system sending the new claim to NPHIES instead of the Follow-up claim ie Un-solicited clarification. System should send the Un-solicited clarification to NPHIES if the User sends the Follow-up request against the claim which has the status either ‘Sent to Insurance’ or ‘Approved’ or ‘Rejected’.

helpdesk-ticket.description:
After we cancel transaction from EDC machine, system is taking more than 1 min to show transaction declined in front end. When we fetch card details after completion of transaction from EDC machine, in ADD BILL SETTLEMENT DETAILS pop-up, user can change CREDIT Card Co. from list of values buttons. If by any means, we sent request and we do not want to proceed with Pinelabs payment then system takes too much time to make screen active as it goes in Processing for more than 1 min. When we take payment from 2 tier, suppose we send request for 57 rupees then in EDC it is showing 5700, from EDC when transaction is completed. Then in front end it shows as Payment Declined in end.
Point no 4, checked same thing on OP deposit it is same and at last we are getting Payment declined.

helpdesk-ticket.description: อ้างถึงปัญหา Performance ที่เกิดขึ้นกับการทำงานของ Blood Analyzer Interface รวมถึงการทำงานที่เพิ่มขึ้นตาม SRR20056-CRF-1014 (Create Blood Bank log after received data from analyzer) ซึ่งใช้เวลาในการประมวลผลนานผิดปกติ โดยบริษัทฯ ได้ชี้แจงว่านอกจากการปรับปรุงโปรแกรมตาม Patch no.11.3.1.000.0.146.004 [SRR20056-SCF-18009] แล้ว ยังมีความจำเป็นที่จะต้องมีการปรับปรุงในส่วนของ Database Performance Tuning จึงขอให้บริษัทฯ ได้นำเสนอคำแนะนำในการดำเนินการดังกล่าวต่อทางศิริราช เพื่อศิริราชจะได้พิจารณาดำเนินการอย่างเร่งด่วนต่อไป
helpdesk-ticket.subject: อ้างอิง 2566-036147 [533303] // ขอปรับปรุงการการรับข้อมูลผลการตรวจหมู่เลือดและผลการตรวจของธนาคารเลือดของผู้ป่วยและผู้บริจาคเลือดระบบ eHIS [SRR20056-CRF-1014]
helpdesk-ticket.description-html:
อ้างถึงปัญหา Performance ที่เกิดขึ้นกับการทำงานของ Blood Analyzer Interface รวมถึงการทำงานที่เพิ่มขึ้นตาม SRR20056-CRF-1014 (Create Blood Bank log after received data from analyzer) ซึ่งใช้เวลาในการประมวลผลนานผิดปกติ
โดยบริษัทฯ ได้ชี้แจงว่านอกจากการปรับปรุงโปรแกรมตาม Patch no.11.3.1.000.0.146.004 [SRR20056-SCF-18009] แล้ว ยังมีความจำเป็นที่จะต้องมีการปรับปรุงในส่วนของ Database Performance Tuning 
จึงขอให้บริษัทฯ ได้นำเสนอคำแนะนำในการดำเนินการดังกล่าวต่อทางศิริราช เพื่อศิริราชจะได้พิจารณาดำเนินการอย่างเร่งด่วนต่อไป

helpdesk-note.body: Hi Amr Elsokary, As per our previous discussion in "CUST1381914" The customer should've been notified not to rely on "Stock balance report" in the balance quantities otherwise it will be disabled to avoid customer confusion. Kindly find below the previous reply on CUST1381914 "It is unlogic for the system to have 2 reports with the exact same data set, but we can retrieve the desired data by combining 2 reports. N.B. The Stock balance report has a different UOM logic not an incorrect issue logic. So we have 2 solutions to avoid customer Confusion. Use "Stock status report" that already display the unit cost, Balance and committed quantities, in combination with other reports that shows issued and received qt like "Transaction Summary report". Or Use the "Stock balance report" for Issued, received and unit cost with no rely on the balance qt reported here, in combination with the "Stock status report" to retrieve the Balance and committed quantities. Please provide the customer with these two options and if they chose option number 2, please make sure they understand the logic of UOM issuing in this report and assure they are going to use the Stock status report not the stock balance report for tracking the Balance to avoid any confusion." ​ Regards, AdeaHub
helpdesk-note.body-html:
Hi Amr Elsokary,

As per our previous discussion in "CUST1381914" The customer should've been notified not to rely on "Stock balance report" in the balance quantities otherwise it will be disabled to avoid customer confusion.

Kindly find below the previous reply on CUST1381914 

"It is unlogic for the system to have 2 reports with the exact same data set, but we can retrieve the desired data by combining 2 reports.
N.B. The Stock balance report has a different UOM logic not an incorrect issue logic.
So we have 2 solutions to avoid customer Confusion.
  1. Use "Stock status report" that already display the unit cost, Balance and committed quantities, in combination with other reports that shows issued and received qt like "Transaction Summary report".
  2. Or Use the "Stock balance report" for Issued, received and unit cost with no rely on the balance qt reported here, in combination with the "Stock status report" to retrieve the Balance and committed quantities.
Please provide the customer with these two options and if they chose option number 2, please make sure they understand the logic of UOM issuing in this report and assure they are going to use the Stock status report not the stock balance report for tracking the Balance to avoid any confusion."
​
Regards,
AdeaHub

helpdesk-note.body: Hi Brunei Technical Team, Hi Klyder Anak Rimpang, Hi Brunei Technical Team, Hi Brunei Technical Team, Is there any specific reason for stopping EGNC OGG replication from RIPAS? As per the agreed RIPAS performance impact arrangement, all outbound replication data from RIPAS is expected to be maintained in real time, as there is no performance impact. Even if replication was paused during limited daytime peak hours, the data should still be available in EGNC by end of day (EOD), correct? We are currently observing missing data at EGNC. Kindly investigate this issue and provide us with an update at the earliest. Appreciate your prompt support on this matter. ​ Regards, AdeaHub
helpdesk-note.body-html:
Hi Brunei Technical Team, Hi Klyder Anak Rimpang,
Hi Brunei Technical Team,
Hi Brunei Technical Team, 

Is there any specific reason for stopping EGNC OGG replication from RIPAS?

As per the agreed RIPAS performance impact arrangement, all outbound replication data from RIPAS is expected to be maintained in real time, as there is no performance impact. Even if replication was paused during limited daytime peak hours, the data should still be available in EGNC by end of day (EOD), correct?

We are currently observing missing data at EGNC. Kindly investigate this issue and provide us with an update at the earliest.

Appreciate your prompt support on this matter.
​
Regards,
AdeaHub

helpdesk-ticket.description: Currently the Formulary Billing Group functionality delivered against GHL-CRF-0618 is working fine for a Single Facility created for a Site. The same functionality is failing in the multifacility for a Site. The requirement is to allow creating records in “Formulary By Billing Group” function facility wise. In the same Data Base, there are two Facilities created for Ranchi and Patana Hospitals. The Drug formulary is created for Patana Facility and unable to create Formulary billing Group for Ranchi facility. System is validating the details in DB level not for the facility. The desired functionality is to create Formulary Billing Group for multiple facilities created in the same database.

helpdesk-ticket.description: Dears, This ticket is just to check if this is an expected behavior from emmses servers 10.24.12.179 10.24.12.180 as swap size is almost fully utilized on them Apparently this was the case from the beginning but we know it now due to alert activation. Here are the Red hat findings : Swap usage is confirmed to be almost fully utilized (~4 GB) on both nodes. Despite high swap usage, the systems still have ~25 GB of available memory, and CPU and I/O utilization are within normal ranges. Kernel version: 5.14.0-427.13.1.el9_4 (RHEL 9.4). No known kernel fixes related to swap/memory behavior are listed for this release. Historical SAR data is not available, as sysstat was enabled only shortly before the SOS reports were collected. Current vm.swappiness value is 30 (already lower than default), yet swap usage remains high. No application performance degradation has been observed so far; however, alerts are being triggered due to high swap utilization.
helpdesk-ticket.subject: INC000000015104
helpdesk-ticket.description-html:
Dears,
This ticket is just to check if this is an expected behavior from emmses servers 10.24.12.179 10.24.12.180 as swap size is almost fully utilized on them
Apparently this was the case from the beginning but we know it now due to alert activation.

Here are the Red hat findings :
Swap usage is confirmed to be almost fully utilized (~4 GB) on both nodes.
Despite high swap usage, the systems still have ~25 GB of available memory, and CPU and I/O utilization are within normal ranges.
Kernel version: 5.14.0-427.13.1.el9_4 (RHEL 9.4). No known kernel fixes related to swap/memory behavior are listed for this release.
Historical SAR data is not available, as sysstat was enabled only shortly before the SOS reports were collected.
Current vm.swappiness value is 30 (already lower than default), yet swap usage remains high.
No application performance degradation has been observed so far; however, alerts are being triggered due to high swap utilization.

MMS Feed back ; Thanks for your feedback! Initially we were using NLS_LANG in all report servers with AMERICAN_AMERICA.AR8MSWIN125.
Due to QR code changes and other barcode label changes team requested us to go with NLS_LANG AMERICAN_AMERICA.UTF8, during this changes time we were using two servers and managed for time being. Because the QR code printing was critical and no time to check and fix all the dependent reports/labels. Later stage we open as SCF for specimen label and get it.
The entire EM module is printing labels/ reports with AMERICAN_AMERICA.UTF8 , for BT/BD module alone having the issue and from our side difficult to manage separate report server.

helpdesk-note.body-html:
Dear @Nandhini Devi Lakshiyavathy , 
 
Thanks for your feedback! Initially we were using NLS_LANG in all report servers with AMERICAN_AMERICA.AR8MSWIN125.
 
Due to QR code changes and other barcode label changes team requested us to go with NLS_LANG AMERICAN_AMERICA.UTF8, during this changes time we were using two servers and managed for time being.
